[P2] Finish examples-package coverage for llm.ask

The examples fixture covers the four decider methods, but `llm.ask` still lacks examples-package coverage. This handler requires manual deployment, and the live test is skipped by default, leaving this public API outside the regular cloud integration workflow. Root AGENTS.md Tests rule 3 and CONTRIBUTING require examples for new APIs. Return to the testing design and include `llm.ask` with result and history assertions; an injected Bedrock client can supply deterministic replies without a deployed model.
